## Provenance and use

- The GitHub repository does not declare a licence in its metadata. Public access alone does not establish reuse permission.
- All ENA-listed runs under the linked BioProject are indexed. Confirm the article-specific sample subset before combining or analysing files. ENA serves the linked FASTQ copies; NCBI remains linked at project and run level.
- Files are linked at the original host; data.ccmi does not mirror external data bytes.
- File roles and categories are inferred from names and repository context. Data dictionaries, temporal coverage, units and quality flags have not been transcribed or independently audited.
- Named regions are descriptive. No precise coordinates are inferred or plotted.

## FAIR readiness

Findable: separate paper, dataset and concept DOI fields, repository accessions, searchable file entries and parent relationships. Accessible: direct HTTPS source links plus repository landing pages. Interoperable: JSON-LD, JSON and Markdown metadata; source units and dictionaries require review. Reusable: retain source licence, creator statements, exact versions and repository checksums where reported. Null values are unverified, not inferred. Full file transfers and scientific validity have not been tested.
